Mod.name: Field Imbue
Mod.description:
Adds [b]Field resonance[/b], a new modifier for circle spells (Circle of fervour, stillness, thunder, ...).
Cast it together with a circle and any other modifiers. The circle then: [list] [*] gives those modifiers to every projectile that flies through it: a Spark bolt through a Burning trail circle comes out burning, through a Homing circle it homes, through a Heavy shot circle it hits harder [*] keeps applying their effects (fire, freeze, oil, poison, ...) to enemies standing inside it [*] runs their material converters (Water to poison, ...) over the whole circle [/list] Works with 130 vanilla modifiers, and modifiers from other mods are picked up automatically. Circles cast without Field resonance stay vanilla.
[b]Settings[/b] (apply from the next new run): [list] [*] Imbue enemy projectiles (off): circles also imbue enemy shots [*] Allow Nuke orbit and Chaos magic (off): lets circles hand those out too - can cause heavy lag [/list] [b]Entangled Worlds[/b]: works in multiplayer. Every player needs the mod and the same settings.
Source, notes and issues: https://github.com/MrWong99/noita-field-imbue (MIT)
